summary: Profile page becomes a dashboard: five KPI cards (saved, useful, irrelevant, too hard, this week's activity) with this-week/last-week counts and 12-week sparklines, an interest-term bar chart with pinned terms on top, an explicit-feedback donut showing the useful rate (useful / (useful + irrelevant), sample size shown, flagged below 5, too hard excluded), a 12-week stacked bar chart whose columns open that week's evidence, a week-over-week comparison with rising/falling terms only when the weeks are comparable, and recent feedback with undo. The scattered disclaimers collapse into one line; the correction section and every evidence/undo/pin/freeze action are unchanged.
scope_note: Frontend only; reuses /api/profile/insights unchanged. Shares the uncommitted worktree with 2026-09-30-project-creation-switcher and 2026-09-30-knowledge-detail (docs/HANDOFF.md is edited by all three).

budget_impact.rationale: Static JS/CSS presentation computed from existing local counts; no model call, prompt, provider or external request added.
budget_impact.before: Zero model tokens on the profile view.
budget_impact.after: Zero model tokens on the profile view.

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; the evidence file also records the node tests (organization UI, project switcher, profile dashboard).

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; exercised KPI, week-column and term evidence dialogs, term expansion and the pin-edit jump in the browser preview at 1280px and ~800px, light and dark mode.

open_risks: The useful rate is a ratio of explicit labels, not a measurement of recommendation quality; with few labels it swings widely (flagged in the UI below 5).
Exposures usually dwarf feedback in the weekly bars, so feedback segments look short; exact counts are in the tooltip and evidence dialog.
Layout below 760px follows the CSS rules but was not viewed on a device.
